notes.title: Feature Updates
notes.content:
1.Fixed several bugs.
2.Added hexagon and jigsaw puzzle types.
3. Adjusted the frequency of hints to once every 10 minutes

notes.title: Add the functionality to upload local images or videos to the Creative Workshop.
notes.content:
Notes:

1. The size of the preview image must not exceed 1Mb.
2. The total size of uploaded content and the disk storage for local archives should not exceed 1Gb."
